consequence.statement: Purely additive feature: the release note states only that customizing the signature algorithm is now allowed and states no change to existing behavior, so environments that do not opt in are unaffected and no operator action is required.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds the ability to customize the signature algorithm.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence names only the feature; it does not state whether it is exposed as a CRD field, Helm value, flag or other mechanism, nor its exact name/path.; applicability: The release note does not state how the feature is configured (no CRD field, Helm key, flag or gate is named), so no environment condition can be built.
